conventions: Simulators / interactive tools MUST run CLIENT-SIDE (browser JS) - never as server-side per-request compute. This box is shared and serves the live dashboard; a runaway server-side sim can OOM/thrash it. Ship a self-contained static page under ~/website/public/<name>/ and bake heavy precompute into static JSON the page loads (e.g. /passive_sim, /ct1_borst).
gotchas: side/soma_side left-right is FLIPPED (FAFB image-view vs fly-view) - do NOT trust the label for anatomical L/R. It is positional (side=left => low soma_x, side=right => high soma_x; midline soma_x ~133,300 voxels ~533k nm) but the naming is inverted: judge hemisphere from soma position - HIGHER x = fly LEFT, LOWER x = fly RIGHT. Helper: flydata.hemisphere(rid).
Positions in skeletons & synapses_full are nm (skeleton-aligned); do NOT multiply by [4,4,40]. CAVE table pt_position is voxels; local neuron_information_v2.json pt_position is nm.
synapses_full includes autapses (~9.7%); filter pre_root!=post_root for the ~193.7M conventional connectome.
Two neuron universes: 112,790 community-named (neuron_information_v2) vs 139,255 proofread; matrix & synapses are proofread-scoped.
/descending is MANC/male-CNS (neuPrint) - a DIFFERENT dataset than FAFB.
cleft_score has NO default threshold (matches published connectome); filter >=50 for high-confidence.
root_ids are v783; new roots from CAVE -> verify with chunkedgraph.is_latest_roots.
Skeletons are NOT on the CAVE skeleton service (NoL2CacheException) - use local CSVs / flydata.
